lines.text: I spelled my ring's name wrong.
On purpose. And I'm never fixing it.
It started on a road trip to Vancouver. A driftwood tree, with a walking stick.
I spent hours turning it into a ring.
A jewellery workshop shaped it in sterling silver.
Not a tree that walks. A tree that woke up.
A reminder... you can do anything.
The Waking Tree. Back it on Kickstarter.
